name: @gjsify/integration-devtools-cdp
description: Integration test: @gjsify/devtools-cdp's InspectorProtocolClient against a LIVE WebKit remote inspector (ported from refs/webkit LayoutTests/inspector). Opt-in + skip-if-unreachable — needs a real browser, not headless/CI.

scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --globals auto --outfile dist/test.gjs.mjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test:gjs && gjsify run test:gjs
